learning_outcomes.text: Students gain sufficient knowledge in topics specific to the Chemical Engineering discipline.
Students gain the ability to use theoretical and applied knowledge in Chemical Engineering to solve complex engineering problems.
Students gain the ability to effectively use information technologies.
Students gain the ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing, and to make presentations.
Students gain the ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.
